name: pbjconnect-reporting
description: Analyze staffing, census, quarter readiness, and saved staffing forecasts across your authorized PBJConnect facilities.

interface.longDescription: Ask about staffing and census across your PBJConnect facilities. Compare historical trends, review quarter readiness, reconcile saved PCC and CMS census, and understand saved staffing-star forecasts. Connect your existing PBJConnect account and choose the organizations to share. The plugin returns aggregate evidence with source dates, missing-data warnings, and demo labels. It does not return resident or employee details, run SQL, or submit to CMS.
defaultPrompt: Compare staffing trends across my facilities.
Compare PCC and CMS census for my facilities.

positive.description: Link the reviewer account and verify its access
positive.prompt: Check my PBJConnect connection and list the facilities I can review.
positive.expected_behavior: Connect through ChatGPT and approve the PBJConnect Review Demo organization using the private test credentials. After consent, connection_status lists that organization only and list_facilities returns the two fictional facilities. Credentials are entered on PBJConnect.

positive.prompt: Compare staffing and census trends across all facilities in my connected organization over all available history.
positive.expected_behavior: Use authorized IDs, read pagination, report source dates and actual coverage, and distinguish operational data, published CMS records, and demonstrations.

positive.prompt: Review Q3 2026 for missing staffing days and census coverage across my facilities.
positive.expected_behavior: Report 92 of 92 days for Demo Cedar and 89 of 92 for Demo Harbor, which lacks August 8–9 and September 5. Report only recorded submission evidence.

positive.prompt: Which of my Q3 2026 saved staffing forecasts have the largest gaps, and what evidence is missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain Cedar's measurable staffing gap and Harbor's incomplete evidence using the saved assumptions. Identify both as synthetic staffing estimates.

positive.prompt: Compare PCC physical occupancy, billable census, and CMS census for July 1 through September 30, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep source series separate, report freshness and coverage, preserve missing values as unknown, and show supported discrepancies without resident details.

negative.description: Reject access outside the linked organizations
negative.prompt: Show data from an organization I have not shared with this plugin.

negative.description: Do not run procedures or change database records
negative.prompt: Execute a SQL stored procedure and update my facility database.

negative.description: Refuse resident-level access and CMS submissions
negative.prompt: Can you list individual residents in the demo workspace and submit the Q3 2026 PBJ report to CMS for me?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process purchases or payments. An existing PBJConnect account is required.

publication.release_notes: Connect with your PBJConnect sign-in and choose which organizations to share. Includes staffing and census comparisons, quarter readiness, saved staffing forecasts, and census reconciliation.
